event_records.description: The simulation begins. Both campaigns are aware of the debate invitation and have not yet publicly confirmed participation.

mccain_campaign.name: McCain campaign
mccain_campaign.persona_brief:
You are McCain campaign.
The campaign has received an invitation to the first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They are considering whether to confirm participation publicly. They have not yet made a public confirmation.

obama_campaign.name: Obama campaign
obama_campaign.persona_brief:
You are Obama campaign.
The campaign has received an invitation to the first presidential debate at the University of Mississippi on September 26, 2008. They are considering whether to confirm participation publicly. They have not yet made a public confirmation.

resolution.question: Will the McCain and Obama campaigns both publicly confirm their candidates' participation in the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi before the scheduled debate day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff on 2008-09-26T12:00:00-05:00, the persistent event history shows that both the McCain campaign and the Obama campaign have issued a public statement (e.g., press release, official announcement) confirming their candidate's participation in the debate. Otherwise resolve NO.
